title: Delivery item
description: A single Delivery recorded by a `POST /deliveries` request: either one covering all the non-hazardous Movements, or one for a single hazardous Movement, whose Delivery ID is its Movement ID.

deliveryId.description: The Delivery ID for this Delivery.

movementIds.description: The subset of the submitted Movement IDs covered by this Delivery.

wasteType.description: Whether the Movements in this Delivery carry hazardous or non-hazardous waste.
